coverage.evidence: server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Models/SetupWizardDtos.cs:83-92 sets Required: true and Complete: hasTwitchDecision for twitch_app; dashboard/src/views/site/setup/SetupView.vue:41-43 and 124 keep Next disabled until a required step is complete.

server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Controllers/V1/SystemController.cs:318-328 saves the Twitch secret only when one is supplied and says the bot falls back to device code; SetupWizardDtos.cs:121-127 labels the field Client Secret (optional).

dashboard/src/views/site/login/LoginView.vue:60-63 sets codeOnly when the selected bot is not the served origin or when !window.isSecureContext (https or localhost), and lines 131-134 show the role buttons only when codeOnly is false. The card cites 55-58; the logic is at 60-63.
SetupWizardDtos.cs:138-143 sets platform_bot Required: false with the description 'Skip it and the broadcaster account acts as the bot.'

SystemController.cs:276-277, 314-315, 353-354, 377, 425, 449 and 474-475 return Forbid when setup is complete and the caller is not admin, so the key writes are open to anyone before that and admin-only after.
SystemController.cs:469-479 sets system.setup_complete only on POST setup/complete, and lines 482-491 read completion from that flag alone; SetupView.vue:48-51 calls it from the Finish setup button.
dashboard/src/views/site/setup/i18n/en.json:12-23 (Back, Next, Skip, the step labels) and 37-41 (Finish setup); StepsFrame.vue:57-64 adds Finish as the sixth entry.
A GET of https://dev.twitch.tv/docs/authentication/register-app says to verify the account email before proceeding and that you must enable two-factor authentication.

reader_answers.evidence: Only twitch_app is Required (SetupWizardDtos.cs:87, 142, 163, 188, 213); the shared app or Save with a Client ID is the recorded decision (SystemCredentialsProvider.cs:84-98); Finish setup is SetupView.vue:117-120.

The wizard loads from the running bot or shows the unreachable notice (SetupView.vue:60-68); Twitch requires a verified email and 2FA (register-app doc); the bot authorize URL needs the client id and secret (AuthService.cs BuildAuthorizeUrlAsync returns TWITCH_NOT_CONFIGURED when GetAsync is null, SystemCredentialsProvider.cs:57-58).

Next turns on after the wizard query is refreshed on save or use-shared (api/setup.ts:93, 111; SetupView.vue:41-43); BotAccountStep.vue:57-59 shows Connected: {name}; SetupView.vue:96-99 shows Done or Not set; SetupView.vue:50 goes to /app, and router/guard.ts:95-101 sends an unauthenticated visitor to login.

use-shared records the decision (SystemController.cs:348-365); the shipped app has an empty secret (appsettings.json:33), so the bot authorize URL fails (AuthService.cs BuildAuthorizeUrlAsync) and redirect sign-in fails; the code link is 'Sign in with a code instead' (login/i18n/en.json:22); SetupView.vue:44-46 and 127 show Skip on optional steps.
